title: Hidden Power of Your Knees

scenes.text: Your knees generate 300 watts of power while you walk.
During steady walking the quadriceps can produce about 150 watts of mechanical power.
When sprinting the leg muscles can exceed 500 watts, the highest output of any body part.
Your knee joint works like a tiny generator, storing elastic energy and releasing it as electrical charge.
Hit follow for your daily dose of wow.

description: Your body hides astonishing power sources you never imagined. Discover how the knee turns every step into a mini‑generator. Follow for more mind‑blowing body facts!
